title: Orthogonality Conditions
description: Essential Criteria: The student must demonstrate that H is orthogonal to E, D, and K.

title: Transverse Properties
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that D and H are transverse to K, while E is not.

title: Component Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the equation S_j sum(i=1 to 3) S_i E_i + (V^2/V_j^2 - 1) E_j = 0.

title: Phase Velocity Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student must write the equation for phase velocity V in terms of S and V_j.

title: Roots of Propagation
description: Important Criteria: The student must show that the derived equation has two finite roots for V^2.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes or incorrect assumptions about the transverse nature of E.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or special scenarios for the derived equations.
